# TorchScan

> Inspect PyTorch model cost, measure a workload, check an optimization, and consume JSON or offline HTML evidence with explicit metric status.

TorchScan v0.2 requires Python 3.11+ and PyTorch 2.1+. Use reports for model structure, parameters, module estimates,
operator FLOPs, and peak PyTorch memory. The development version adds workload timing/throughput, fresh-process RSS,
operator diagnostics, checked benchmark comparisons, and offline reports. Always check metric status, methods,
scopes, and diagnostics. Hardware measurements apply to the recorded workload and machine; the owner supplies budgets
and output-quality requirements. `measure_workload` assembles selected resources in one report; it is preview PR #176
until merged. Install the preview as described in the installation guide.

## Documentation

- [Agent quickstart](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/agent-quickstart.html): Safe default workflow for coding agents.
- [Report schema](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/report-schema.html): AnalysisReport, MetricResult, Diagnostic, FlopReport, and ReportDiff contracts.
- [Methodology](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/methodology.html): Module hooks, operator dispatch, uncertainty, memory, and reproducibility.
- [Model and input support](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/model-support.html): Generated inputs, args/kwargs, execution state, and coverage.
- [Custom module extensions](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/extensions.html): Per-analysis handlers, complete call context, subtree ownership, operator overrides, and complex counting.
- [Understanding results](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/metrics.html): Metric meanings and comparison limits.
- [Checked performance experiments](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/benchmark-comparison.html): Baseline/candidate output checks and offline workload reports.
- [Workload memory and bottlenecks](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/workload-diagnostics.html): Fresh-process RSS, scoped memory, and separate profiler passes.
- [v0.2 migration guide](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/migration-v02.html): Breaking changes from v0.1.
- [API reference](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/torchscan.html): Public Python API.
- [Peak-memory reference](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/process.html): Owner-controlled workload memory measurement.
- [Changelog](https://frgfm.github.io/torch-scan/changelog.html): Release history.
